description: Japanese additional taxes and delinquency tax: failure-to-file (5% voluntary; after notice 10/15/25%, after audit 15/20/30% on parts over 500,000 and 3,000,000 JPY; NTA No.2024), underpayment (none if voluntary; 5/10% after notice, 10/15% after audit above the larger of original tax and 500,000; No.2026), heavy additional tax 35%/40% (国税通則法 第68条), and 2026 delinquency tax 2.8% up to 2 months then 9.1% (No.9205). Tax base rounded down to 10,000 JPY, additional tax under 5,000 and delinquency under 1,000 are zero. Japan, as of 2026-11-21 (e-Gov current law and NTA Tax Answer). General information and estimates only; individual tax advice and return preparation are reserved to 税理士 (税理士法 第52条).

fraud.description: Concealment or disguise found (heavy additional tax)

kind.description: none = late return (無申告), under = amended return (過少申告)

stage.description: voluntary = before audit notice, notice = after notice before audit, audit = after audit
